sloka: एतदिन्द्रजितो नाम बलं यत्कीर्तितं मया ।निर्जितस्तेन देवेन्द्रः प्राणिनो ऽन्ये तु किं पुनः ।। ७.३०.५१ ॥
transliteration: etadindrajito nāma balaṁ yatkīrtitaṁ mayā ।nirjitastena devendraḥ prāṇino 'nye tu kiṁ punaḥ ।। 7.30.51 ॥

translations.english: This is the power of Indrajit that I have recounted, by which even the lord of gods, Indra, was conquered; what then to speak of other living beings?
